nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel for the Cursor native provider, declaring and re-exporting auth, client, connect, proto, provider, request, and tools submodules.

nodes.name: pipeline_tests.rs
nodes.summary: End-to-end integration tests for the Cursor native provider's drive_run streaming pipeline, covering text/thinking/tool-call deltas, MCP-exec pause/resume, cancellation, and Connect-RPC end-stream error propagation using canned server responses.

nodes.name: collector
nodes.summary: Test helper that collects all StreamDelta events emitted by a drive_run invocation into a Vec for assertions.

nodes.name: text_delta
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor server message representing a plain text delta.

nodes.name: thinking_delta
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor server message representing a thinking-content delta.

nodes.name: token_delta
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor server message representing a token/usage delta.

nodes.name: turn_ended
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor server message signaling the end of a turn.

nodes.name: mcp_tool_call
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor MCP tool-call server message.

nodes.name: tool_call_started
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor interaction message signaling a tool call has started.

nodes.name: partial_tool_call
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor interaction message with partial tool-call argument content.

nodes.name: tool_call_completed
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a canned Cursor interaction message signaling a tool call has completed.

nodes.name: drive_run_aggregates_text_turn
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run aggregates a sequence of streamed text deltas into a single coherent assistant turn.

nodes.name: drive_run_streams_partial_interaction_tool_args_before_completion
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run streams partial interaction tool-call argument deltas to the caller before the tool call fully completes.

nodes.name: drive_run_splits_complete_only_create_plan_into_title_and_content_deltas
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying a complete-only create_plan interaction tool call is split into separate title and content stream deltas.

nodes.name: drive_run_splits_exec_mcp_create_plan_into_title_and_content_deltas
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying an exec-channel MCP create_plan call is split into separate title and content stream deltas.

nodes.name: drive_run_short_circuits_on_mcp_args
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run short-circuits and pauses immediately when it detects ORGII MCP-style arguments on an exec call.

nodes.name: drive_run_pauses_immediately_on_empty_mcp_exec_args
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run pauses immediately when an MCP exec call arrives with empty arguments.

nodes.name: mcp_exec_args_require_same_stream_result
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying MCP exec-channel tool calls require their result to be delivered back on the same exec stream.

nodes.name: paused_mcp_tool_result_is_sent_as_mcp_result_on_same_exec_stream
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying a paused MCP tool result is delivered back to Cursor as an MCP result on the originating exec stream.

nodes.name: paused_native_tool_result_is_sent_on_same_exec_stream
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying a paused native (non-MCP) tool result is delivered back to Cursor on the originating exec stream.

nodes.name: native_exec_args_map_to_orgii_tools
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying native Cursor exec call arguments map correctly onto ORGII's internal tool-call representation.

nodes.name: handle_exec_maps_native_write_before_mcp_fallback_rejection
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying a native write exec call is mapped to an ORGII tool call before any MCP-fallback rejection logic applies.

nodes.name: mcp_tools_trigger_native_cursor_tool_rejection
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying that when ORGII advertises MCP tools, Cursor's native equivalent tools are rejected in favor of the MCP path.

nodes.name: drive_run_ignores_empty_exec_server_message
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run tolerates and ignores an empty/no-op exec server message without erroring.

nodes.name: drive_run_answers_request_context_with_tools
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run answers Cursor's initial RequestContext query with the correct advertised tool definitions.

nodes.name: drive_run_answers_kv_blob_get
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run correctly answers a KV GetBlobArgs request from Cursor's backend during a run.

nodes.name: drive_run_honors_cancel_flag
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run stops streaming promptly when the caller's cancellation flag is set.

nodes.name: drive_run_tolerates_stream_end_without_turn_ended
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run completes gracefully when the stream ends without an explicit turn_ended message.

nodes.name: drive_run_propagates_connect_end_errors
nodes.summary: Integration test verifying drive_run propagates a Connect-RPC end-of-stream error as the appropriate ORGII ProviderError.

nodes.name: proto.rs
nodes.summary: Includes the prost-generated protobuf bindings for Cursor's agent.v1.AgentService wire types.

nodes.name: provider.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CursorNativeProvider, the top-level LLMProvider for Cursor, orchestrating session-token auth and the drive_run streaming state machine that pumps Connect-RPC server messages into ORGII stream deltas.

nodes.name: take_pending_run
nodes.summary: Removes and returns a tracked PendingCursorRun by its continuation token, consuming it so a tool result can resume the paused stream.

nodes.name: conversation_id
nodes.summary: Returns the stable Cursor conversation id for the current session.

nodes.name: set_stable_conversation_id
nodes.summary: Sets the stable Cursor conversation id derived from the session context, ensuring subsequent turns reuse it.

nodes.name: from_session_token
nodes.summary: Constructs a CursorNativeProvider from a raw Cursor session token with default workspace context.

nodes.name: from_session_token_with_workspace
nodes.summary: Constructs a CursorNativeProvider from a session token and explicit workspace context, extracting and validating the embedded JWT.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a CursorNativeProvider with default settings.

nodes.name: new_with_workspace
nodes.summary: Constructs a CursorNativeProvider with an explicit CursorNativeWorkspaceContext.

nodes.name: chat
nodes.summary: Non-streaming LLMProvider::chat entry point for Cursor, aggregating a full chat_streaming/drive_run into a single response.

nodes.name: chat_streaming
nodes.summary: Top-level Cursor streaming entry point: builds the AgentRunRequest, opens the Connect-RPC run via client::start_run, and pumps the connection through drive_run, translating results into ORGII StreamDelta events and mapping errors.

nodes.name: begin_logical_turn
nodes.summary: Marks the start of a new logical conversation turn, resetting per-turn tool-stream tracking state.

nodes.name: drive_run
nodes.summary: Core streaming state machine that pumps Cursor's Connect-RPC server messages (interaction updates, exec calls, KV requests, turn-ended) into ORGII stream deltas, pausing on tool calls and resuming when results arrive.

nodes.name: CursorNativeProvider
nodes.summary: Top-level LLMProvider implementation for Cursor, holding session-token auth state, workspace context, and pending/paused run tracking.

nodes.name: CursorRunOutcome
nodes.summary: Wraps the terminal outcome of a Cursor drive_run invocation (success, pause, or error).

nodes.name: CursorNativeWorkspaceContext
nodes.summary: Workspace metadata (root path, descriptors) passed to Cursor at the start of a run to scope its native exec tools.

nodes.name: request.rs
nodes.summary: Builds Cursor's AgentRunRequest protobuf from ORGII's flat message list, splitting it into content-addressed history-turn blobs (SHA-256) and a current action via a state-machine message splitter.

nodes.name: message_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain text content from one ORGII chat message.

nodes.name: preview
nodes.summary: Truncates a message's text to a short preview snippet for inclusion in request-summary logging.

nodes.name: log_request_summary
nodes.summary: Logs a condensed, log-safe summary of the outgoing Cursor request for debugging.

nodes.name: extract_tool_calls
nodes.summary: Extracts the list of tool calls embedded in an ORGII assistant message.

nodes.name: tool_result_continuation_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the continuation prompt text sent to Cursor when resuming a paused run with a tool result.

nodes.name: split_messages
nodes.summary: State-machine that splits ORGII's flat OpenAI-style message list into historical HistoryTurns and the CurrentAction to send to Cursor, handling system/user/assistant/tool role transitions.

nodes.name: build_run_request
nodes.summary: Public two-line entry point that delegates to build_run_request_with_context using default context.

nodes.name: build_run_request_with_context
nodes.summary: Main Cursor request builder: splits messages via split_messages, stores the system prompt and each history turn as SHA-256-addressed protobuf blobs, and assembles the final AgentRunRequest and BlobStore.

nodes.name: encode_turn
nodes.summary: Encodes one HistoryTurn into its protobuf wire representation, including any tool-call steps, for blob storage.

nodes.name: BuiltRunRequest
nodes.summary: The fully-built Cursor AgentRunRequest plus the blob store containing the content-addressed system prompt and history turns.

nodes.name: tool_stream.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks in-flight interaction-based tool-call argument deltas keyed by both Cursor's call id and ORGII's call id, so partial JSON-argument chunks can be completed and matched back to the right tool call.

nodes.name: complete_tool_call_argument_deltas
nodes.summary: Finalizes the accumulated argument-delta text for a tool call once its arguments are fully streamed.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a new in-flight tool call in the InteractionToolStreamState, resolving its ORGII-facing tool name via tools::resolve_cursor_mcp_tool_name and indexing it by exec_bridge::cursor_tool_call_id.

nodes.name: entry_for_cursor_call_id
nodes.summary: Looks up the tracked tool-stream entry for a given Cursor-side call id.

nodes.name: index_for_orgii_call_id
nodes.summary: Looks up the tracked tool-stream entry's index for a given ORGII-side call id.

nodes.name: mark_partial
nodes.summary: Marks a tracked tool-stream entry as having emitted at least one partial argument delta.

nodes.name: has_emitted_partial
nodes.summary: Reports whether a tracked tool-stream entry has already emitted a partial argument delta.

nodes.name: InteractionToolStreamEntry
nodes.summary: Tracks one in-flight interaction-channel tool call's accumulated argument-delta text and completion state.

nodes.name: InteractionToolStreamState
nodes.summary: Registry of in-flight interaction-channel tool calls keyed by both Cursor's call id and ORGII's call id, used to route argument deltas and completions.

nodes.name: tools.rs
nodes.summary: Translates between ORGII's OpenAI-style tool-call model and Cursor's MCP protobuf wire format, including JSON to google.protobuf.Value bridging and per-tool-type result encoders for ls/read/grep/shell/write/delete/task.

nodes.name: strip_cursor_mcp_definition_prefix
nodes.summary: Strips the ORGII MCP-provider-identifier prefix ('orgii') from a Cursor MCP tool definition name.

nodes.name: resolve_cursor_mcp_tool_name
nodes.summary: Resolves a Cursor-side MCP tool name back to ORGII's internal tool name by stripping the provider prefix.

nodes.name: json_to_pb_value
nodes.summary: Converts a serde_json Value into Cursor's google.protobuf.Value wire representation, widening integers to f64 (lossy by design).

nodes.name: pb_value_to_json
nodes.summary: Converts a google.protobuf.Value back into a serde_json Value.

nodes.name: encode_json_as_pb_value_bytes
nodes.summary: Encodes a JSON value directly to protobuf-serialized google.protobuf.Value bytes.

nodes.name: decode_pb_value_bytes
nodes.summary: Decodes protobuf-serialized google.protobuf.Value bytes back into JSON, falling back to raw-JSON parsing for legacy payloads.

nodes.name: build_tool_definitions
nodes.summary: Converts ORGII's tool registry into a list of Cursor McpToolDefinition protobuf messages advertised at the start of a run.

nodes.name: mcp_args_to_tool_call
nodes.summary: Converts incoming Cursor McpArgs into ORGII's internal ToolCallRequest shape.

nodes.name: encode_tool_call_step
nodes.summary: Encodes one historical tool call as a protobuf turn-step message for inclusion in a history-turn blob.

nodes.name: historic_tool_call_from_result
nodes.summary: Constructs a HistoricToolCall from an ORGII tool-call request and its result message.

nodes.name: encode_historic_tool_call
nodes.summary: Dispatches a HistoricToolCall to the correct per-tool-type protobuf encoder based on its tool name.

nodes.name: encode_mcp_exec_tool_result_message
nodes.summary: Encodes a completed MCP-channel tool result as the protobuf message sent back to Cursor on the exec stream.

nodes.name: encode_exec_tool_result_message
nodes.summary: Dispatches a completed tool result to the correct per-tool-type exec-result protobuf encoder based on the tool name.

nodes.name: encode_task_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a subagent 'task' tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: encode_mcp_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a generic MCP tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: mcp_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds a generic MCP tool result from a completed ORGII tool call.

nodes.name: ls_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds the list-directory tool result from a completed ORGII list_dir tool call.

nodes.name: encode_ls_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a list-directory tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: read_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds the read-file tool result from a completed ORGII read_file tool call.

nodes.name: encode_read_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a read-file tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: shell_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds the shell-execution tool result from a completed ORGII run_shell tool call.

nodes.name: encode_shell_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a shell-execution tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: write_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds the write-file tool result from a completed ORGII edit_file tool call.

nodes.name: encode_write_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a write/edit-file tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: delete_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds the delete-file tool result from a completed ORGII delete_file tool call.

nodes.name: encode_delete_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a delete-file tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: grep_result_from_call
nodes.summary: Builds the code-search tool result from a completed ORGII code_search tool call.

nodes.name: encode_grep_tool_call
nodes.summary: Encodes a code-search (grep) tool call into its Cursor protobuf wire representation.

nodes.name: grep_workspace_result
nodes.summary: Parses a whole-workspace grep result payload into structured match data.

nodes.name: grep_files_union_result
nodes.summary: Parses a files-only grep result payload (matching file paths without content) into structured data.

nodes.name: grep_content_union_result
nodes.summary: Parses a content-union grep result payload (matching lines with content) into structured data.

nodes.name: parse_grep_content_matches
nodes.summary: Parses raw grep output text into a list of individual content matches.

nodes.name: parse_grep_output_line_with_separator
nodes.summary: Parses one line of grep output using an explicit field separator into file/line/content components.

nodes.name: HistoricToolCall
nodes.summary: A previously-executed tool call (id, name, arguments, result text) replayed into a history turn's protobuf encoding.
